sloka: युवराजं पुरस्कृत्य सुग्रीवमभिवाद्य च ।प्रवृत्तिमथ सीतायाः प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमुः ।। ५.६५.२ ।।।।
transliteration: yuvarājaṁ puraskṛtya sugrīvamabhivādya ca ।pravṛttimatha sītāyāḥ pravaktumupacakramuḥ ।। 5.65.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the vanaras arrived at the Prasrvana mount, with wonderful forests and bowed down to Sri Rama and mighty Lakshaman and Sugriva placing their leader, heir apparent in front. Then they began telling the story of Sita and her state.
